[[File:Crossfire_menu.jpg|thumb|350px]]'''Crossfire''' is a Spotlight Mission featuring [[Jetfire]] that ran from December 7 to January 10, 2019. == Changes/Rewards == * All Bot Chip amounts are now doubled. * Master Rewards are full T3 Alpha Sparks instead of a half. * New Master Completion Reward: T2 Mod Spark Crystal * New [[Objectives]] for Mastering each difficulty. This mission introduces Minibosses in Chapters 2 and 3, with buff a unique to them. == Chapter 1 - Ghosts of the Past == ===Be Not Afraid=== Part 1 *[[Marissa Faireborn]]: ''Teletraan is reporting a new abnormality in Deception activity. I'm requesting all Primes and the Commander on deck for this one.'' *[[Optimus Prime]]: ''What seems to be the quandary?'' *Marissa: ''Everything within range of scans is swapping signals! First a desertion of Deceptions, then a flood of them.'' *[[Optimus Prime (MV1)]]: ''Can you propose a location for us to rally?'' *Marissa: ''Up ahead there's one specific signal that is reading Autobot, with a background radiation of Decepticon circuitry.'' *[[Optimus Primal]]: ''A Decepticon in disguise? Seems like a place to start.'' Part 2 *[[Jetfire]]: ''That's far enough Decepticons! Posing as Primes, have you no shame?'' *Optimus Prime: ''Skyfire! Is that you?'' *Jetfire: ''My designation is Jetfire! Calculate carefully before you speak next, imposters.'' *Optimus Prime (MV1): ''Too young to be the Jetfire I know. Same blunt attitude however.'' *Optimus Prime: ''An Autobot by any name is a welcomed sight. If you just allow us to explain-'' *Jetfire: ''Enough of your charade! There is not a Prime amongst you, one of your ranks couldn't even copy the form correctly!'' *''Honestly, an APE?! As a PRIME?'' *Optimus Primal: ''If I wasn't sympathetic to your confusion, I may begin to take offense.'' Part 3 *Jetfire: ''I have been studying this world since my arrival. Duplicates, Dark Energon pockets, and timelines overlapping or rewritten.'' *Optimus Primal: ''It can be a lot to take in, time travel is never a simple thing to accept.'' *Jetfire: ''From my observations, I can only assume you represent a threat and I must take preventative measures.'' *Optimus Prime: ''What can we do to prove we are Autobots through and through?'' *Jetfire: ''I believe in what my optics report and my sensors measure. When you and your human can fight like Primes, I'll start trusting you.'' *Optimus Prime (MV1): ''You heard him Commander, show what kind of Sparks burn inside us!'' ===Of Greatness=== Part 1 *Jetfire: ''I've searched this area to track the pulse of Decepticon energy. I've returned with a few...contradictory findings.'' *Optimus Prime: ''In what way?'' *Jetfire: ''I've seen Autobots turn on each other. Bases defended by Decepticons and Autobots alike. A path to a war that I wish to never see.'' *Optimus Primal: ''It can be a strange world. But many of us remain as you remember.'' *Jetfire: ''There is one whom I remember, their signal is nearby. I have hopes that this world changed them for the better.'' *Optimus Prime (MV1): ''Hope is a luxury we are often not afforded.'' Part 2 *[[Starscream]]: ''Are my optics faulty? Have the fates brought me closure and delivered Skyfire to me?'' *Jetfire: ''My designation is Jetfire. Chaos and misfortune brought me here Starscream, but perhaps we may serve a purpose.'' *Optimus Prime: ''This is who you were seeking out, Jetfire?'' *Jetfire: ''Back on Cybertron he and I were paired as scouts. For the sake of efficiency, he would be an ideal candidate as we can scan for the source of Decepticon abnormalities.'' *Starscream: ''Feeling homesick? I'm not in a nostalgic mood.'' *Jetfire: ''It's for a greater good!'' *Starscream: ''Since when is being good so great?'' Part 3 *Starscream: ''I've detected a thing or two, but I don't share secrets with weaklings. You'll have to prove yourself worthy of my assistance.'' *Jetfire: ''It would be hypocritical of me to deny a challenge I so recently requested.'' *Optimus Primal: ''Agreed, I say we indulge him.'' *Jetfire: ''I take no pleasure in this, Starscream.'' *Starscream: ''Don't worry, I'll take plenty for both of us.'' == Chapter 2 - Enemies of the Present == ===Uneasy Lies the Head=== Part 1 *Jetfire: ''Starscream, what is waiting for us ahead?'' *Starscream: ''Suffering, punishment, and ultimately defeat.'' *Optimus Prime (MV1): ''You may wish to adjust your tone, or we shall make adjustments for you.'' *Starscream: ''Old habit, my new and fearless leader. the Decepticons are gathering fresh forces.'' *Optimus Primal: ''More Decepticons leaders are being brought over? Another beastly Megatron?'' *Starscream: ''No, they're brining over those who are known to follow orders. A Tactician in this case.'' Part 2 *[[Bumblebee (DOTM)]]: ''I was told some Autobot scrap heaps were headed over here for a fight.'' *Optimus Prime (MV1): ''Bumblebee? What is your malfunction?'' *Starscream: ''He's not your Bumblebee, Prime. He is part of the Decepticon plan.'' *Optimus Prime (MV1): ''Dark Energon again? Hardly a new tactic.'' *Starscream: ''Not quite, they are using a Spacebridge to access an ancient Dark Realm. This Bumblebee is a Decepticon loyalist.'' *Jetfire: ''Confirmed, the only Autobot sources registering from him are on...'' *''...his knuckles.'' *[[Bumblebee (DOTM)]]: ''A bit of sparring practice, but don't worry I have plenty of fight left in me for all of you.'' Part 3 *[[Megatron (ROTF)]]: ''Enjoying yourselves, Autobots?'' *Optimus Prime (MV1): ''This is your plan? Break our spirit by forcing us to destroy reflections of those under my command?'' *Megatron (ROTF) ''Do not pretend to be a leader, Prime! You are a butcher. you have torn apart many a Bot whom you deemed unworthy!'' *Optimus Prime (MV1): ''Our world knew more brutality than most. However, I only did what was necessary to protect innocent lives.'' *Megatron (ROTF): ''Then you understand that when I snuff the Sparks of three Primes, I do it to save all Decepticons kind!'' *Optimus Prime (MV1): ''I understand...that you will try.'' ===That Wears a Crown=== Part 1 *Jetfire: ''How are they accessing the Spcebridge? The Energon required for transreality transfer is near incalculable.'' *Starscream: ''They weren't exactly keeping me in the loop. I just know the general area that everyone seemed to be headed.'' *Optimus Prime (MV1): ''Are you telling us that even the Decepticons do not trust you?'' *Starscream: ''I may have a reputation for myself. It's not as though I'm the only disloyal Decepticon, is it Jetfire?'' *Jetfire: ''I am loyal to logic and science. All the facts presented proved to me that the Decepticons served only as instruments of destruction.'' *Starscream: ''Ah, but what lovely music those instruments make.'' *Optimus Primal: ''Less chatter, more movement. We need to stop this plan as soon as possible.'' *Starscream: ''As you command.'' Part 2 *[[Bumblebee]]: ''Well, well...if it isn't a platoon of Primes and turncoats looking for another beehive to bother.'' *Jetfire: ''Commander, this duplicate Bumblebee is not the same model as the one we previously encountered. Fresh tactics and no mercy is advised.'' *Starscream: ''No mercy? Perhaps I am on the right team. Human participant or not.'' *Bumblebee: ''You brought a human with you? It has been some time since I made one fear my fury.'' *Optimus Prime: ''You will find our Commander is made of sterner stuff.'' *Bumblebee: ''Oh, I plan to discover EXACTLY what they are made of.'' Part 3 *[[Megatron]]: ''Does it awaken anything in you? This unrestrained violence against your friends?'' *Optimus Prime: ''You lack originality Megatron. Will you all be just retreading the same plan over and over?'' *Megatron: ''Prime, until you can repeat the results of a test...you've not really progressed in your findings.'' *Jetfire: ''I am reluctant to agree with the details, but not the purpose, of that observation.'' *Megatron: ''However, while my counterpart left you functioning, I shall take you offline.'' *Jetfire: ''You'll find the conclusion of this contrary to your hypothesis.'' == Chapter 3 - Visions of the Future == ===Passing Through Nature=== Part 1 *Jetfire: ''I'm having concerns that you're leading us to these battles intentionally, Starscream. *Starscream: ''I understand your fears, but truly I am leading you to the source of all this!'' *[[Galvatron]]: ''The truth? From you Starscream? This is bad comedy.'' *Starscream: ''Autobots! What you seek is just beyond this quadrant. Meet with me there!'' *Galvatron: ''Typical cowardice, this is why I have chosen a worthy opponent to serve as my personal lieutenant.'' *[[Ultra Magnus]]: ''Did you summon me, Leader Galvatron?'' *Optimus Prime: ''By the Architect!'' Part 2 *Ultra Magnus:''Come to donate your scrap to the cause? Our army requires fresh salvage.'' *Optimus Prime: ''Ultra Magnus! It has been months, I thought you were lost to the wastelands.'' *Ultra Magnus: ''My last memory was fighting YOU Optimus, until both our Sparks were extinguished...then I awoke here with a purpose, and a duty.'' *Optimus Prime: ''This duplicate madness must come to an end.'' *Ultra Magnus: ''If you are looking for an end, it will be provided.'' Part 3 *Optimus Prime (MV1): ''Galvatron! If yo have access to a Spacebridge why pervert its purpose to terrorize us rather than use it to escape?'' *Galvatron: ''This world does not wish for our escape, something more all-encompassing and consequential is at hand!'' *Jetfire: ''Would you care to clarify your terms, or is cryptic speech your only refuge?'' *Galvatron: ''You shall understand the grandeur of my words...when I send your Sparks to meet with oblivion.'' ===To Eternity=== Part 1 *Starscream:
DECEPTICONS! THE PRIMES AND TRAITOR HAVE BEEN LEAD TO YOU!!!
*Optimus Prime: ''I wish I had a single circuit that could register this as a surprise, you triple-faced betrayer!'' *Jetfire: ''Why? Why brother?! What could this madness possibly have to offer you?'' *Starscream: ''FOOL! I gain that which I have always wanted! AN ARMY TO COMMAND!'' *Jetfire: ''Who would follow your twisted will?'' *[[Sharkticon]]:
WE AWAIT YOUR ORDERS LEADER STARSCREAM!
*Optimus Primal: ''Primus save us...the inmates have taken over the asylum! All that's missing is-'' *[[Megatronus]]: ''Welcome to your doom, Autobots. We have been eager for your arrival.'' *Optimus Primal: ''Well...that's just PRIME.'' Part 2 *Optimus Prime (MV1): ''I thought our Commander and their team sealed you in the bowels of this world, Megatronus.'' *Megatronus: ''Yes, and I thank them for the glorious honor they bestowed upon me!'' *Optimus Primal: ''Your higher functions pick up a virus? What madness are you spouting?'' *Megatronus: ''You call this world New Quintessa...the Quintessons barely touched the skin of it. I have awoken the TITAN we dwell upon.'' *Optimus Prime: ''You are a Cityspeaker now?'' *Megatronus: ''We share a more ancient understanding. An alignment beyond what Caminus and his mere messengers could have hoped for.'' *Jetfire: ''I shudder to think how broken a mind needs to be done before it could align with yours.'' *Megatronus: ''Have you not seen the replication of other worlds in the midst of their destruction? This plante begs for war, and is a nemesis of life. This Titan is ...'' *
A DECEPTICON.
Part 3 *Megatronus: ''I have lived in the yawning expanse of the beyond. Unfathomable darkness has been awaiting and embrace us as it kin.'' *Jetfire: ''I turned from the Decepticon cause. I'm certain this world can be shown the light of truth as well.'' *Megatron:
YOU ARE MISTAKEN, DESERTER!
*[[Cyclonus]]:
WIN OR LOSE...
*Megatron (ROTF):
...THIS WORLD IS OURS...
*Galvatron:
...AND WE BELONG HERE!
*Megatronus: ''Make you last stand, Autobot scum. Eternity awaits.'' *Optimus Prime (MV1): ''Commander...'' *Optimus Prime:
ROLL OUT!
